question: 2022 Paralympics winter games was held in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2022 Paralympics winter games** were held in **Beijing, China.**
 
• The Paralympics winter games are a **multi-sport event **for athletes with physical disabilities, including those with** mobility disabilities, amputations, blindness, and cerebral palsy, among others.**
 
• **China** has hosted the **Paralympics summer games** twice before, in** 2008 and 1984,** but this was the first time they hosted the **Paralympics winter games.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **China**, the host nation for the 2022 Paralympic Winter Games, took **first place** in the medal standings with **61 medals.**

 
 
• With **29 medals, Ukraine** had their best-ever result and came in **second.**
 
• With **25 medals** overall, **Canada** maintained its** third place** finish from 2010, 2014, and 2018.
 
 
 
• **Russia **is a prominent country in winter sports, having hosted the **2014 Winter Olympics** in **Sochi**.
 
 
• However, they were **banned** from participating in the 2018 Winter Olympics due to a **doping scandal.**
 
 
 
• **India and Japan** have **not yet** hosted the Paralympics winter games, although **Japan** is set to host the **summer games in 2021.**
